item.title: [19 Oct] Flutter on Autopilot: Agent Skills, MCP and an AI That Runs Your App
item.description:

Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

Flutter has quietly become one of the best frameworks to build with an AI agent. Google now ships official Agent Skills that teach it Flutter conventions, a Dart MCP server for the analyzer, tests and hot reload, and MCP tools that let it launch the app, tap through screens and take screenshots. Together, apart from writing code, the Agent runs the app, checks its own work and fixes what's wrong. We'll go through each piece, which skills, plugins and MCP servers are worth installing, and how they fit together. AI can help us build dashboards faster than ever before. But faster does not automatically mean better.
